$comment: The code-highlight manifest (plan P3-22; design T9 A6): the one definition of the languages, their aliases,
the capture aliases, the overlays and the fence profiles. A new built-in language is one entry here.
Generated from it (tools/gen-all.mjs): the worker's and the editor's tables (tools/gen-languages.mjs:
(engine/src/code/languages.gen.h), the native build's (engine/native_grammars.gen.cmake) and the editor's
fence and overlay grammars (tools/gen-grammars.mjs); tools/codehl-assets.mjs builds the web grammars.
classes: the token classes in syntax.def's TOKEN_TAGS order, each with the editor's semantic token type
(null: left plain). alias: a capture name's first segment → its class.
languages: aliases = more fence tags; textmate = the editor grammar scope its fences embed; grammar = the
tree-sitter sources (paths from the repository root) and its highlight queries, base first; native = the
native build links it (goldens), and its queries may use only the string predicates #eq? #not-eq? #any-of?
#not-any-of? (no regular expressions: the twins share none).
overlays: spans the engine finds in a code body itself (open, a name without the forbid characters, close,
an optional suffix, the longest first) and sets as one token of its class whatever the provider says.
profiles: a fence tag that means a language with overlays (a default rule sets codeblock.overlays).

tsm.$comment: our own markup: the engine answers it itself (plan P1-09); the grammar is the editor's cold start and the native conformance check
